notTranslated: Ba a fassara wannan jagora ba tukuna, don haka ana nuna shi da Turanci.
sectionInEnglish: Wannan sashe ya canza tun da aka fassara shi, don haka ana nuna shi da Turanci har sai an sabunta fassararsa.

list.title: Jagorori
list.lead: Jagorori cikin sauƙaƙan harshe ga sababbin magina: daga mene ne glaze zuwa gasa shi, da kiyaye lafiyar kowa a hanya.
list.note: Waɗannan jagorori suna tattara abin da masana’antu, hukumomin aminci da gogaggun magina ke wallafawa, tare da madogara a ƙarshen kowanne. Mafari ne, ba madadin takardun bayanan aminci (safety data sheets) na kayanku, littafin jagorar kiln ɗinku ko dokokin yankinku ba.

glazingBasics.title: Tushen glaze
glazingBasics.text: Mene ne glaze, yadda yake narkewa, da kowace kalma da za ku haɗu da ita a girke-girke ko a jaka, an bayyana.

makingAGlaze.title: Yadda ake haɗa glaze
makingAGlaze.text: Saye, ajiya, aunawa, haɗawa da tace glaze, sannan gwada shi da riƙe bayanai.

safeMixing.title: Haɗawa cikin aminci da iska mai kyau
safeMixing.text: Ƙura, respirator, tsaftacewa, kayan da suka fi buƙatar kulawa, da fitar da hayaƙin kiln.

homeSafety.title: Kada ka sa wa iyalinka guba
homeSafety.text: Ginin tukwane a gida tare da yara da dabbobin gida: ajiya, ƙura, kiln, da abin da za a yi idan an haɗiye wani abu.

firing.title: Gasa a cikin kiln mai sauƙi
firing.text: Cone, kiln sitter da maɓallan hannu, tare da jadawalin gasa bisque da gasa glaze.

learnWithJohnBritt.title: Koyi da kwas ɗin glaze na kyauta na John Britt
learnWithJohnBritt.text: Kwas ɗinsa na bidiyo kyauta a YouTube, darasi bayan darasi, tare da jagororinmu don karantawa da atisaye don gwadawa a Glazecalc. Da Turanci.

cones.title: Teburin cone
cones.text: Orton da SK cone tare da zafinsu a °C da °F, da inda kowane adadi ya fito.

materials.title: Kaya na yau da kullum
materials.text: Kowane kaya a laburare tare da nazarin oxide ɗinsa, gudummawarsa ga unity formula da haɗarinsa.

stull.keyCrazed: Zane-zanen layuka: inda suka yi crazing.
stull.note: Jagora ce, ba hasashe ba. R. T. Stull (Transactions of the American Ceramic Society, 1912) ya gasa a cone 11 da flux a tsaye a 0.3 K₂O da 0.7 CaO; wasu flux da gasa suna motsa yankunan, kuma marar sheƙi da ba a gasa isasshe ba zai iya bayyana a matsayin mai haske. Yankunan suna yadda Glazy ke zana su.
